## Source snapshot

- Application branch/commit:

## Evidence trace

- [ ] UI or route inspected
- [ ] Handler inspected
- [ ] Service/repository inspected
- [ ] Persistence and side effects confirmed
- [ ] Supporting tests identified
- [ ] Contradictions or unconfirmed behavior stated explicitly

## Public boundary

- [ ] No credentials, secret values or private endpoints
- [ ] No real personal or financial records
- [ ] No local absolute paths

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Application drift check, when application source is available
- [ ] `mint validate`
- [ ] `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects`
- [ ] `mint a11y`
- [ ] Local browser navigation verified
